description: Create a shortcut (link) to a file or folder in Google Drive. Useful for referencing the same document from multiple locations without duplicating it.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

parentFolderId.description: ID or path of the folder where the shortcut will be created

shortcutName.description: Custom name for the shortcut (defaults to original file name)

targetFileId.description: The file or folder ID (not a path) to create a shortcut to

name: createShortcut
